figures.title: Foreign participation in China's onshore bond repo has roughly doubled
figures.analysis: The image plots two settlement series from September 2025 through August 2026. One series is pledged repo. The other is outright repo. The vertical scale is marked at 5,000, 10,000, and 15,000, in units of 100 million yuan. A footnote says that at the end of September 2025 the central bank let a wider set of overseas institutions in the interbank bond market use bond repo, including commercial banks, insurers, brokers, asset managers, pension funds, and charity funds. The source line is ChinaBond and Bloomberg.

marketTone: September payrolls rose only 29,000 and the unemployment rate was 4.2%, but the official 30-year yield still finished at 5.63%. The S&P 500 rose 0.7% to 7,722.72. November WTI settled at 91.11 after the G7 set a 100 million barrel release, while December Brent held at 102.25. Euro-area flash inflation printed 3.8%, with energy at 18.8%.

summary.text: BLS: nonfarm payroll employment rose by 29,000 in September and the unemployment rate was 4.2%. July and August together were revised down by 60,000.
US Treasury: the 2 October curve printed 4.83% on the 2-year, 5.06% on the 5-year, 5.28% on the 10-year, and 5.63% on the 30-year, after 4.78%, 5.01%, 5.24%, and 5.61% on 1 October.
AP: the S&P 500 rose 56.27 points, or 0.7%, to 7,722.72, the Dow rose 250.40 points, or 0.5%, to 51,176.96, and the Nasdaq rose 319.27 points, or 1.2%, to 27,190.86.
Eurostat: euro-area flash inflation is 3.8% in September after 3.2% in August, and energy is 18.8% after 14.3%.
华尔街见闻: November WTI settled down 1.90% at 91.11, December Brent settled down 0.06% at 102.25, and October COMEX gold settled down 0.94% at 4133.7. The Hang Seng fell 2.6% to 23972.29.
G7 leaders: a coordinated release through the IEA of 100 million barrels begins immediately and runs over 4 months, including a front-loaded diesel release in the first 20 days.

signal: Payrolls rose only 29,000 and unemployment was 4.2%, but the official 30-year yield still closed at 5.63% after 5.61%. November WTI settled at 91.11, under Thursday's 92.87, after the G7 release, while December Brent held at 102.25. Euro-area flash inflation is 3.8%, led by energy at 18.8%. The French premium over Germany widened past 140.6 basis points.
watch: US ISM services is today at 22:00 Beijing, estimate 55 after 55.4. Nagel, Lane, and Schnabel speak today. September FOMC minutes are 2pm ET on 7 October, which is 02:00 Beijing on 8 October. Shanghai reopens 8 October, the same day as the PBOC reverse repo. Full euro-area HICP is 16 October. The next FOMC decision is 28 October, after this window.

themeCards.title: The official curve gave back the post-payroll rally
themeCards.fact: US Treasury: the 2 October curve printed 4.83% on the 2-year, 5.06% on the 5-year, 5.28% on the 10-year, and 5.63% on the 30-year, after 4.78%, 5.01%, 5.24%, and 5.61% on 1 October. BLS: nonfarm payroll employment rose by 29,000 in September and the unemployment rate was 4.2%.
themeCards.mechanism: The jobs gain was only 29,000 and unemployment was 4.2%, but the 30-year still finished at 5.63% after 5.61% and the 2-year at 4.83% after 4.78%, so the post-payroll bond rally did not last. CICC (22 August): the real rate has been the main push on the nominal yield, and the credit worry can still swing that rate. USTs carry the 5.63% long yield. The theme changes if the official 30-year reprints at or below 5.61%.
themeCards.trigger: Official 30-year holding above 5.63% with the 2-year still above 4.83%.

themeCards.title: The reserve release put WTI back under Thursday's settle
themeCards.fact: G7 leaders: a coordinated release through the IEA of 100 million barrels begins immediately over 4 months, with a front-loaded diesel release in the first 20 days. 华尔街见闻: November WTI settled down 1.90% at 91.11, and December Brent settled down 0.06% at 102.25. 第一财经: Thursday's November WTI settle was 92.87.
themeCards.mechanism: November WTI at 91.11 finished under Thursday's 92.87, while December Brent at 102.25 barely changed, so the reserve release hit the US benchmark harder than the international one. CICC (21 September): with inventories lower than before, the oil price can still swing widely. Oil carries the 91.11 settle and the 102.25 settle. The theme changes if a later WTI settle rises back through 92.87.
themeCards.trigger: A later WTI settle above 91.11 while the release is underway.
themeCards.invalidator: A later WTI settle rising back through 92.87.

themeCards.title: The French premium over Germany widened past 140 basis points
themeCards.fact: Global Financial Market Review: on 2 October the French 10-year gap over Germany widened past 140.6 basis points, after a Reuters reading of 132.86 basis points on 1 October.
themeCards.mechanism: The French premium moved from 132.86 basis points on 1 October to past 140.6 basis points on 2 October, so France is paying a wider gap over Germany. 财经早茶 (5 October): that premium is the widest since the 2011 crisis, and the open question is whether the ECB slows hikes because of the stress. OATs and Bunds carry the wider gap. The theme changes if the French premium over Germany reprints at or below 140.6 basis points.
themeCards.trigger: The French 10-year premium over Germany staying above 140.6 basis points.
themeCards.invalidator: The French 10-year premium over Germany reprinting at or below 140.6 basis points.

themeCards.title: Euro-area inflation re-accelerated on energy
themeCards.fact: Eurostat: September flash HICP is 3.8% after 3.2% in August, and energy is 18.8% after 14.3%.
themeCards.mechanism: Energy at 18.8% after 14.3% is leading the jump from 3.2% to 3.8%, so the flash is an energy-led inflation print. CICC (10 June): a higher oil price can pass into core inflation and lift longer-term inflation expectations. Bunds and the euro carry the 3.8% flash. The theme changes if the final print reprints at or below the 3.2% August rate.
themeCards.trigger: Eurostat final September HICP at or above 3.8% with energy at or above 18.8%.
themeCards.invalidator: Eurostat final September HICP at or below the 3.2% August rate.

themeCards.title: October gold settled lower after yields rose back
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻: October COMEX gold settled down 0.94% at 4133.7.
themeCards.mechanism: October gold at 4133.7, down 0.94%, gave back the jump that followed the payrolls report once yields rose into the close. CICC (1 July): hike expectations already in the gold price can ease. Gold carries the 4133.7 settle. The theme changes if a later COMEX gold settle rises back through 4133.7.
themeCards.trigger: A later COMEX gold settle at or below 4133.7.
themeCards.invalidator: A later COMEX gold settle above 4133.7.

themeCards.title: Foreign onshore China bond-repo settlement has roughly doubled
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 今日图表: foreign participation in onshore China bond repo has roughly doubled, on pledged repo and outright repo, in the ChinaBond series running from September 2025 through August 2026.
themeCards.mechanism: The larger foreign repo book is a funding link into China's bond market. 财经早茶 (5 October): the footnote dates the wider access to the central bank notice at the end of September 2025. Shanghai is shut, so this series moves no cash-equity book yet, and the exposure is China bonds. The theme changes if that settlement volume stops rising from a year earlier.
themeCards.trigger: The ChinaBond foreign repo series still up from a year earlier when it next updates.
themeCards.invalidator: The year-on-year rise in foreign onshore repo settlement stops.

themeCards.title: China ADRs fell for a second day while US indexes rose
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶: the Nasdaq Golden Dragon China index fell for a second day, with Maase and NetEase the largest drags.
themeCards.mechanism: US indexes rose on the same tape, so the second down day in China ADRs is a China-specific sleeve. 财经早茶 (5 October): the UK is reported to be preparing tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles. China ADRs carry that tariff risk. The theme changes if the Golden Dragon index rises for a session.
themeCards.trigger: The Golden Dragon index falling for another session.
themeCards.invalidator: The Golden Dragon index rising for a session.

themeCards.title: US spot bitcoin ETFs finished the week with a net inflow
themeCards.fact: 律动: US spot bitcoin ETFs had a net inflow of 8290万美元 in the week reported on 4 October, citing Farside Investors.
themeCards.mechanism: A weekly net inflow means the ETF flow finished positive after a softer day earlier in the stretch. 财经早茶 (5 October): bitcoin was higher in the morning snapshot as the dollar fell back. Bitcoin carries that weekly flow. The theme changes if the next weekly ETF print is a net outflow.
themeCards.trigger: The next weekly US spot bitcoin ETF flow still a net inflow.
themeCards.invalidator: The next weekly US spot bitcoin ETF flow printing a net outflow.

globalRegime: A soft September jobs report failed to hold the Treasury rally, and the official curve finished higher on the day. The G7 reserve release knocked WTI under Thursday's settle while Brent barely moved. Euro-area inflation jumped on energy, and the French premium over Germany widened further. Mainland markets stay shut. The chart is foreign participation in onshore bond repo.

globalChanged.text: 财经早茶：美国9月非农就业人数增加2.9万，低于预期，前两个月的数据也遭下修，失业率小幅上升。数据公布后，互换市场定价显示美联储本月加息的概率降至约20%。
财经早茶：克利夫兰联储行长称美联储下次会议前有时间权衡更多数据，她认为美联储在实现充分就业方面做得相当不错，真正担心的是通胀。
财经早茶：美国财长贝森特表示，近期美债收益率上升符合全球趋势，无需恐慌。他认为伊朗战争影响掩盖了美国经济的内在强劲表现，称赞消费者支出强劲。
财经早茶：受法国财政困局冲击，法德10年期国债利差触及欧债危机以来最高水平，投资者警惕风险蔓延迹象，关注欧洲央行是否会因此放慢加息或调整量化紧缩。
财经早茶：欧元区9月消费者价格同比上涨3.8%，超过预期，创下三年来最大涨幅。
财经早茶：OpenAI安全部门员工David Robinson辞职，呼吁AI公司借鉴核电站的防护模式，建立多层冗余安全机制。软银创始人孙正义也罕见地就AI安全风险表达担忧。
财经早茶：苹果宣布将为Mac用户推出新的隐私控制措施，警告向包括AI智能体在内的第三方软件授予广泛数据访问权限的风险正在上升。
财经早茶：美国财长贝森特批评AI风险警告是危言耸听，呼吁行业自我监管并拿出解决方案。他还表示将寻求与中国建立双边通报机制以降低风险。
财经早茶：特朗普宣布成立超级智能工作组，任命国家情报总监Jay Clayton协助领导白宫AI工作组。
财经早茶：G7及其合作伙伴同意释放多达1亿桶紧急石油和柴油储备，以遏制价格上涨。特朗普称美国不会禁止柴油出口。OPEC+主要成员国同意11月维持产量目标不变。
财经早茶：沙特支持的也门部队发动全面攻势，试图夺回胡塞武装控制的所有地区。布伦特原油期货周一亚洲盘初上涨。
财经早茶：俄罗斯国防部表示将加大对乌克兰基础设施的打击力度。俄外交部还警告，身在基辅的外交人员和外国官员处于致命危险之中。
财经早茶：阿联酋检察官称，阿曼籍副驾驶在FlyDubai从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的航班上持紧急救难斧袭击机长并试图夺取飞机控制权，调查认定其意图实施恐怖主义行为。
第一财经：美国9月季调后非农就业人口增加2.9万人，前值增16.2万人。美国9月失业率4.2%，前值4.1%。
华尔街见闻：OPEC+周日决定11月产量配额维持不变。伊朗议长称，条件满足前不会重开霍尔木兹海峡。
律动：10月4日当周美国现货比特币ETF合计净流入8290万美元，其中贝莱德IBIT净流入2.92亿美元，富达FBTC净流出1.679亿美元。

globalImplies.text: If the official 30-year stays above 5.63% after a 29,000 payroll gain, the soft jobs report left the long end higher anyway.
If a later WTI settle stays under 92.87 while Brent stays near 102.25, the reserve release is in the US benchmark and not in the international one.
If the French premium stays above 140.6 basis points while euro-area inflation stays at 3.8%, the ECB is hearing a fiscal-stress argument and an energy-inflation argument at the same time.

globalTensions: Payrolls were soft and the S&P 500 rose, but the official curve still finished higher, with the 30-year at 5.63% after 5.61%. WTI fell to 91.11 while Brent held at 102.25. October gold settled down 0.94% even though the jobs report first looked helpful for bullion. China ADRs fell for a second day on a tape where US indexes rose.
chinaStance: Mainland markets and Stock Connect stay closed through 7 October and reopen on 8 October, when the PBOC is scheduled to run 12000亿元 of 3-month outright reverse repos. The morning chart is the rise in foreign onshore bond-repo settlement. Trade friction is the live policy tape, from UK electric-vehicle tariffs to an anti-dumping case and a US chip-export charge.

chinaChanged.text: 财经早茶：中国国际贸易谈判代表李成钢在二十国集团贸易部长会议上呼吁加强产业政策对话合作，反对单边主义和保护主义。
财经早茶：《泰晤士报》报道称，为满足欧盟的要求，英国准备对中国电动汽车征收关税。欧盟已明确表示，如果英国不在关税问题上采取行动，可能被排除在“欧洲制造”计划之外。
财经早茶：中国对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销调查。
财经早茶：美国联邦检察官逮捕一名加利福尼亚州男子，指控他违反美国出口管制，向中国走私装有英伟达AI芯片的电脑服务器。
财经早茶：野村上调阿里巴巴2027财年经调整净利润预估，看好其电商业务盈利前景，并重燃对该公司AI云的信心。
财经早茶：知情人士透露，贝恩资本考虑投资陷入困境的香港地产巨头新世界发展，郑氏家族也可能在交易中注入新的资金。
财经早茶：东亚银行表示，离岸人民币稳步升值的趋势将会延续，而澳元仍具息差优势，均可考虑作为核心持仓。
财经早茶：彭博汇总的数据显示，驶往中国的超级油轮数量升至4月以来最高水平。
财经早茶：路透报道称，中国据悉要求英美资源承诺稳定向中国供应铜精矿，作为批准其拟议与泰克资源合并交易的一项条件。
财经早茶：美军计划在本月晚些时候举行大规模演习期间，首次在靠近台湾的日本岛屿部署先进的反舰导弹系统，此举可能引发中国不满。
华尔街见闻：A股因国庆假期继续休市。央视称，11月中美人工智能对话将谈风险分类、事件通报，以及把治理放进更宽的多边框架。
华尔街见闻：诺华以5.75亿美元首付款锁定艾博生物的ABO2203，并获得其RNA技术平台其他项目的选择权，协议规模为78亿美元。

chinaImplies.text: If Shanghai reopens on 8 October with the wider foreign repo book already in place, the first session opens with that funding link already built.
If the 8 October operation is the announced 12000亿元 of 3-month outright reverse repos, the reopen day still brings a large mid-term liquidity add.
If the UK does impose the reported electric-vehicle tariff, China ADRs have a trade headline waiting when cash equities reopen.
